# PRD-001: Reports

## Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Priority |
|----|-------------|----------|
| FR-1 | Reports are exportable | Must Have |
| FR-2 | Reports are printable | Should Have |

## Acceptance Criteria

### AC-1: Export a report

Requirement: FR-1

- **Given** a finished report
- **When** the author exports it
- **Then** a file is written
